title: Review an Agent proposal, prepare a requester action, and check its saved outcome
goal: Understand the separate human review and original-requester execution steps without mistaking approval, saved history, or an uncertain reply for a completed provider action.
prerequisites: This is an internal source-only draft for the local preview; installation, release availability and live behavior have not been verified.
An existing Agent proposal with exact bound source, and an authorized independent human reviewer.

For execution: the original requester, original paired desktop session, current workspace/tool access, current commercial access, enabled requester execution, and unexpired exact review. Availability must be checked in the app.
permissions: Record approval records an exact human review; it does not execute the action or transfer reviewer authority to the assistant.
The requester cannot self-approve an independent-review proposal. Only the original requester can prepare or execute its saved action.
Readiness is display metadata, not permission. The server rechecks persisted review, current actor and applicable policy at execution.

steps.instruction: In Agent, inspect the proposal arguments and exact source. If source binding is missing or changed, request a fresh proposal before review. Use Cancel proposal when the requester must stop their proposal; another authorized human performs independent review.
steps.expectedState: Record approval records review only; no provider action runs from that decision.

steps.instruction: In Approved Agent actions, select Check saved action outcome for the proposal before deciding what to do.
steps.expectedState: A saved record or an explicit no-record/read-failure message; this check does not prepare, claim, execute or retry.

steps.instruction: Select Check execution readiness. Read the reason and, when offered, Exact reviewed change and review expiry. If blocked, follow the recovery guidance below.
steps.expectedState: Fresh readiness may offer preparation or execution; approval alone is insufficient.

steps.instruction: When offered, select Prepare reviewed action.
steps.expectedState: A prepared saved action. Preparation does not dispatch the provider action.

steps.instruction: Check execution readiness again after preparation. Verify the saved record and exact effect, then deliberately select Execute approved action once only when offered and intended.
steps.expectedState: A saved confirmed, refused or unconfirmed outcome; completion does not establish deployment/application health.

steps.instruction: To stop an unused prepared action, select Cancel unused action when offered.
steps.expectedState: Cancelled saved history remains readable; it cannot be reused.

expectedOutcome: The user can distinguish review, prepared action and recorded execution outcome, and safely read history when an outcome cannot be confirmed.
limitations: This draft covers the named Agent controls only, not every Agent, Governance, app or website control. Stable help IDs are proposed documentation identifiers, not runtime bindings.

Source contract includes GitHub branch creation, single/multiple file commits, pull-request opening, environment creation, deployment-target configuration and pending identity-provider configuration. Their actual eligibility depends on current server checks and exact input/source binding.

trigger_aws_deploy is present in the execution contract but explicitly blocked by assertAgentActionHttpSourceSupported in the mounted HTTP workflow (workflow_incomplete). Do not describe deployment/restart as available from this panel.
Confirmed means the saved execution record confirms that action. It does not prove application health, deployment health, immutable artifact promotion, rollback readiness or baseline admission.

A failed or empty history read is not proof of complete provider history or permission to retry. No automatic retry, screenshots, demo, shipped-version acceptance, approval or support retrieval activation is evidenced here.
recovery: Readiness expired: check readiness again. Expired or missing exact review requires a genuinely new independent review; never fabricate approval or reuse expired evidence.

Requester/session/access mismatch, execution disabled, unsupported tool or unavailable Governance: stop execution. Read available history and ask the workspace administrator/support to investigate the recorded reason; do not bypass controls or substitute another actor.

Unknown, dispatching, lease_elapsed_unconfirmed, lost/malformed mutation reply or outcome-unconfirmed warning: use Check saved action outcome only. Do not resend, reprepare, repeat execution, clear history or infer success/failure from elapsed time. Escalate unresolved outcomes with non-secret proposal/operation identifiers and observed state.

Refused or operation_consumed: the attempt is consumed even when refused before dispatch; inspect its refusal and retain history. This panel cannot repeat it. Do not create a replacement merely to work around an uncertain/consumed result.
Cancelled: the unused saved action was stopped and its history remains. A cancelled action cannot execute.
No saved record/read failure: this read did not run an action. Do not treat absence or a failed read as proof that an earlier uncertain provider action did not happen.
